277685635.description:
Set of Orthoceras Fossils from Silurian Morocco Polished Shell Specimens
This listing offers a set of Orthoceras fossils from the Silurian period, sourced from Morocco. The fossils are embedded in a dark gray matrix and feature well-preserved, polished shell segments with distinct chamber divisions characteristic of Orthoceras cephalopods. The set includes multiple pieces of varying sizes, with the largest measuring approximately 18 cm (7 inches) in length. A labeled mounting plate with specimen information is attached on the back. Fossils are in good condition with natural surface variations, suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or decorative display.
